title: kate-core: score a digit before a capital
summary: fuzzy_match adds 8 when an ASCII digit is followed by an ASCII uppercase letter. The camel-case score stays 46. The test goes in the existing fuzzy tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: fuzzy.rs has one test module named tests.  Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Do not add a second module with the same name. Add digit_hump. Use this exact let-else. Do not match Option by hand. let Some(previous) = index.checked_sub(1).and_then(|at| chars.get(at).copied()) else { return 0; }; When previous.is_ascii_digit() and chars[index].is_ascii_uppercase(), return 8. Otherwise return 0. score_one adds digit_hump(chars, index) after camel_bonus. Do not touch boundary_bonus, camel_bonus, gap_adjust, next_index, or same_fold. The existing foo_bar_scores_the_documented_hits stays green. FB against fooBar stays 46. fb against foo_bar stays 45. The test a_digit_hump_adds_eight asserts fuzzy_match of ab against a2B is Some with score 47 and positions 0 and 2. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: fuzzy::tests::a_digit_hump_adds_eight
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. ab against a2B scores 39. After the change it scores 47 at positions 0 and 2. The camel-case score of FB against fooBar stays 46.
